missions.name: Bounty Hunting (Surprise)
missions.description: A heavy warship known as the <npc> has been attacking merchants near the <system> system. Destroy it and return to <planet> by <day> for payment (<payment>).

values: A heavy warship known as the <npc> has been attacking merchants near the <system> system. Destroy it and return to <planet> by <day> for payment (<payment>).

missions.name: New Pirates 1
missions.description: Pirates seem to be using strange new ships. Fire Corporation wants you to go investigate, scanning if possible. They will be in <waypoints>."

values: Pirates seem to be using strange new ships. Fire Corporation wants you to go investigate, scanning if possible. They will be in <waypoints>."

children.key: As you look around, you are startled with a sudden shout, "Hey! Captain <first>!"
"Hello, Captain <first>! I've long waited to see you! You have much fame!" He pauses, "But that's not the only reason I wanted to talk to you."
"You are very well known amongst the employees of Fire Corporation. But let's leave that. I have a proposition for you."

"Would you be interested in going on a potentially dangerous mission to <waypoints> to scan some pirates? They seem to be making their own ships, and the heads of Fire Corporation would like to have more info."
(It is OK to disable the pirates, but they can't be killed)

As you touch down, the Fire Corporation worker runs over to your ship. "Thank you, Captain <first>! Fire Corporation will be glad of this information!" He then waits until you step out, and hands you <payment>.

missions.name: New Pirates 2
missions.description: Go to <destination>, a pirate planet, to see if you can find the people who are making the new pirate ships.

values: Go to <destination>, a pirate planet, to see if you can find the people who are making the new pirate ships.

children.key: Before you can even walk back to your ship, the Fire Corporation employee runs back to you. "I just got a call from the Commanders! Can you go to <destination> to see if you can find the person making those ships we had you scan?"
"Sorry, but the last mission was too dangerous. I can't do this."

values: The Commanders are the military leaders of Fire Corporation

children.key: "The Commanders are the military leaders of Fire Corporation."
"Thanks, but this sounds too dangerous. I can't do it."
"I'm sorry to hear that," he pauses. "However, maybe I can convince you otherwise. While I can't go alone, I may be able to send an escort and enough money for clearance."
"What type of ship do you have?"
"My ship? It's fair enough, just a Firestorm."
"Good. I look forwards to traveling with you, Captain <last>."
It takes some time to get the pirates to let you investigate, but eventually you do. The most promising spot is a large factory that has a sign in front: Pirates Inc.
You take a casual stroll closer to the building, but are not allowed entry.

Inside the window you spot the very thing you are looking for: one of the pirate ships. Not only that, but there are enough "NO STEALING SHIP DESIGNS: THIS BELONGS TO JARWHIP PIRATEHEAD - THE ORIGINAL DESIGNER" to tell you that this is really it.

When landing, you look behind yourself and see with alarm that this Wind of Flame is not right behind you! It has been destroyed. However, as you peer closely out, you spot a small shape, perhaps an escape pod.
Suddenly, you get a message to go to a Fire Home docked at Kornephoros. They will be glad to hear your information.

missions.name: New Pirates 2b
missions.displayName: Go to the Fire Home in Kornephoros
missions.description: You found the manufacturers, so go to the Kornephoros system where there is a Fire Home ready for boarding.

values: Go to the Fire Home in Kornephoros
You found the manufacturers, so go to the Kornephoros system where there is a Fire Home ready for boarding.

missions.name: New Pirates 3
missions.description: Since you found Pirates Inc. on <destination>, Fire Corporation wants it taken. You must take part in the attack!

values: Since you found Pirates Inc. on <destination>, Fire Corporation wants it taken. You must take part in the attack!

children.key: For the first time in your life, you are inside a Fire Home, meant to be boarded. Your ship is inside too.
You don't have to wait long before a Fire Corporation security officer comes up. You explain what you saw to him, and he gives you 300,000 credits.
"Now," he says, "would you like to take part in a big battle?"

"Good to see one so enthusiastic about this. We are attacking the pirate planet of <destination> to see if we can capture the 'Pirates Inc.' people. However, the pirates have realized some of our intentions, so we cannot sneak in like before. Are you ready?"
"No, that sounds even more dangerous than just a big battle."
Several Fire Corporation ships have landed before you did, and they went after Pirates Inc.
They seem to be having some trouble - and then the Pirates  Inc. building explodes! A small ship, perhaps a Scout, shoots out from the debris and blast off the planet!
Several ships gear up and chase after it.

Once you have landed, a Fire Corporation officer comes up and hands you <payment>. "I'm sorry about this," she says, "but the pirates escaped. I would ask you to chase them down, but there's a fleet of pirates coming. You should help defend."

missions.name: Pirate-Marauder Investigation 1
missions.description: There is a sale for Christmas on <destination>. Fire Corporation wants you to investigate.

values: There is a sale for Christmas on <destination>. Fire Corporation wants you to investigate.

children.key: As you look around the spaceport, you see several Fire Corporation workers speaking together. Then one of them sees you, and gestures for you to come over.
"Hello, Captain," the other says. "Would you be interested in having a perfectly safe mission that could pay well?"
"The way you said it...doesn't make it seem safe."
He pauses for a moment, but then the other one steps in. "There may be some pirates that will want to attack you, but you will receive 6 million credits!"

"Good. Now, your mission is to go to <destination> because there is a group of ship modifiers there. We want you to go there and see if there are any pirates, for many modified warships are used by Marauders. Also, when you are done, come to Sinter in the Albireo system."

values: After looking around a bit, you notice something going on above. You should probably check it out and report to the Fire Corporation.

missions.name: Pirate-Marauder Investigation 2
missions.description: Report what you saw in Tarazed back to Fire Corporation. You should find them on <destination>.

values: Report what you saw in Tarazed back to Fire Corporation. You should find them on <destination>.

children.key: "Ah! There you are Captain," one of the Fire Corporation workers who recruited you comes over. "What information do you have for us?"
You explain how there was a pirate attack with modified ships fighting some other modified ships.

"Interesting," the worker thinks for a moment. "We will contact you later. Have fun with <payment>! You should get a Firestorm if you don't have one, using that money. It's about as good as a Falcon, but cheaper!"
